note: King Solomon sent the people of Israel home after they celebrated the dedication of the Holy Temple for 14 days (see 2 Chronicles 7:10). Simchat Torah (Rejoicing of the Torah) is the last day after the Feast of Tabernacles (see Leviticus 23:36). We celebrate having read the whole Torah and we start “in the beginning” again in Genesis. * In Israel, this holiday is celebrated the day before.
